shp-anchor: -\caption{SYNTHETIC REHEARSAL, NOT A RESULT. Exploratory positioning of distinct quantities, without an empirically calibrated equivalence to $r$ or an item-specific boundary: the boundaries $a^*(r)$ with the SHP reliability anchor, namely the quasi-simplex estimate (dashed) and its model-based Wald 95\% interval (shaded), the envelope of the nine Heise triplet estimates (hatched; a specification envelope, not a confidence interval), the STARTS sensitivity when admissible (dotted) and, when given, the grid values of $r$ whose synthetic crosswalk range contains the SHP value. The crosswalk ranges are descriptive and do not propagate the uncertainty of the empirical anchor. The anchor is placed without choosing or rounding to a value of $r$ and without interpolating or extrapolating $a^*(r)$.}\label{fig:v4-F6}
